item.title: A California photographer is on a quest to photograph hundreds of native bees
item.description: LOS ANGELES — In the arid, cracked desert ground in Southern California, a tiny bee pokes its head out of a hole no larger than the tip of a crayon.

item.title: LEGISLATIVE ROUNDUP: Shapiro unveils plan to build more housing, reduce costs, create opportunity
item.description: Gov. Josh Shapiro this week announced Pennsylvania’s first-ever comprehensive Housing Action Plan to address critical housing needs across the Commonwealth, outlining the state of housing, providing projections on housing needs, and offering nearly thirty strategic initiatives to ensure every Pennsylvanian has access to safe, stable, and affordable housing.

item.title: Legislators announce funding for fire/emergency medical services companies
item.description: Area legislators on Friday announced funding from an ongoing grant program created by the state legislature and administered by the Pennsylvania Emergency Management Agency and Office of the State Fire Commissioner (OSFC).

item.title: Crooked Branch Cafe in West Pittston holds ribbon-cutting
item.description: WEST PITTSTON — The Crooked Branch Gift Shop, 202 Luzerne Ave., held a ribbon-cutting ceremony for the new take-out coffee café inside the consignment store. On the menu are soup, assorted teas, chai latte, cake pops, gluten-free cookies, brownies, and rice treats. Roback had pizza and beverages available for those attending the ribbon-cutting ceremony. For information about the business, visit its Facebook page at tinyurl.com/4h75c6ywn.

item.title: US military strikes another alleged drug boat in Caribbean, killing 3
item.description: WASHINGTON — The U.S. military said Friday that it has carried out another deadly strike on a vessel accused of trafficking drugs in the Caribbean Sea.

item.title: Paul retires, ending 21-season run as star point guard
item.description: Chris Paul, the “Point God” who was a 12-time All-Star selection and two-time Olympic gold medalist, announced his retirement on Friday in the capper of a 21-season career that will surely merit induction into the Basketball Hall of Fame.
